text:
alex: Heads-up — three customers reported increased 502/504s from Hosted API since ~08:27 UTC. Spike aligns with a midproxy config rollout. Sharing quick curl/traces we collected.

morgan: saw metrics — edge egress errors jump ~3x at 08:26. Any change to TLS/handshake timeouts? :thinking:

julie: I ran a quick curl against the hosted endpoint, got a stalled TLS handshake then a 504 after ~15s.

julie: ```bash
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDACTED" "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate" -d '{"input":"hi"}'
*   Trying 10.20.30.40:443...
* TCP_NODELAY set
* Connected to api.redwood.ai (10.20.30.40) port 443 (#0)
* TLS 1.3 handshake starts
* TLS handshake not completed after 10s; server still handshaking
* Operation timed out after 15001 milliseconds with 0 out of bytes received
```

sam: envoy logs from edge-proxy-3 show repeated: `upstream connect error or disconnect/reset before headers. reset reason: connection failure` around same timestamps.

sam: snippet:
```
[2026-03-17T08:26:12Z] env_ext: upstream reset: reason=CONNECT_TIMED_OUT upstream=10.60.70.12:8443
[2026-03-17T08:26:14Z] env_ext: drain retry count exceeded for connpool
```

morgan: Looks like midproxy (tls-terminator) pods were rolled 08:25-08:27. I see a config bump that reduced handshake timeout from 20s -> 10s in the helm values.

alex: Customer impact: connections that normally succeed with a slow handshake are now hitting the shorter timeout and returning 502/504 from the edge.

julie: Repro steps I used:
- run the same curl with a slow client hello (emulate network delay)
- `openssl s_client -connect api.redwood.ai:443` then pause ~12s before completing handshake
- observed same 504s and `upstream connect timed out` in proxy logs

eng-oncall: temporary mitigation — rolling back tls-terminator handshake timeout to 20s on the midproxy ASG. Rolling now. :wrench:

sre-bot: incident created: INC-20260317-502TLS

morgan: long-term actions: revert aggressive timeout change, add canary gating for handshake-related flags, and emit handshake latency metric to edge dashboards (percentiles + tail). Also consider small bump to client retry/backoff guidance.

alex: Customers notified in support threads with workaround: increase client-side TLS timeout/retries, and our support doc updated with short-term guidance.

julie: after rollback metrics trending down — error-rate returned to baseline around 08:34 UTC. Will collect timeline and put a short postmortem together.

eng-oncall: leaving ops notes in postmortems channel, will attach telemetry and the helm diff.

sam: pushed the helm rollback, monitoring is green. Will follow up if anything resurfaces. :thumbsup:
